name: British Pork Sausage Roll with Radish-Snap Pea Salad & Baked Beans (Two Ways)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.
Remove pastry sheets from box and outer wrapping, then set on the counter to thaw slightly, 20-40 minutes. (The pastry is ready when it unfolds easily but is still cool to the touch.)
When the pastry is almost thawed, preheat oven to 400°F. Line a large baking sheet pan with parchment paper.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 stick celery
1 (227 g) pkg sugar snap peas
½ bunch radish
½ small pkg fresh mint
½ head butter (Boston) lettuce
227 g red grapes

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, trim and small dice celery.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add celery and pork; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until pork is browned and crumbly, 3-4 minutes. Remove filling from heat and set aside to cool slightly, 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
454 g lean ground pork
½ tsp Italian seasoning
½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp onion powder
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place egg and water in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the egg wash and set aside.

Lightly dust a work surface with flour. Working one by one, unroll each pastry sheet. Divide filling between the sheets, shaping the filling into a log shape along the long side of the sheet. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)

Brush the long edge opposite the filling with egg wash, then roll tightly to close, pressing the edge to seal. Slice one of the rolls in half crosswise, and the other roll into six equal pieces. Transfer to the baking sheet, brush with remaining egg wash, then prick the top of each roll with a sharp knife.
Place baking sheet in the oven and bake until pastry is golden and filling is cooked through, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, return skillet (with drippings) to medium-high heat. Add beans and cook, stirring occasionally, until warmed through, 2-3 minutes.
While the beans are cooking, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp white wine vinegar
1 tsp Dijon mustard
1 tsp honey
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Halve snap peas. Place 1 cup of snap peas on a plate and set aside. Add remaining snap peas to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and slice radishes crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl, along with feta and almonds, then toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ (113 g) pkg crumbled feta cheese
⅛ cup almonds, sliced

instructions.primary_message:
FOR THE KID PLATES: Divide small sausage rolls between plates, along with reserved snap peas and grapes.  

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Divide remaining sausage rolls, beans, and salad between plates. Enjoy!
